blocks.text: There are two types of vector multiplications. The product of these two types are known as scalar product and vector product.
If the product of two vectors results in a scalar quantity then it is called scalar product while if the product of two vectors results in a vector quantity then it is called vector product.
bold: If the product of two vectors results in a scalar quantity then it is called scalar product while if the product of two vectors results in a vector quantity then it is called vector product.
